sloka: ये ते अंगद परीवारा वानरा हि महाबलाः ।ते सकार्मुकम् आलोक्य रामम् त्रस्ताः प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥४-१९-५॥
transliteration: ye te aṁgada parīvārā vānarā hi mahābalāḥ ।te sakārmukam ālokya rāmam trastāḥ pradudruvuḥ ॥4-19-5॥

translations.english: Alarmed at the sight of Rama holding the bow, the terribly courageous monkeys who followed Angada as his bodyguards ran in different directions.
